content.text: No PB-side non-compete exists. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 3.19 Exclusivity Commitment of SFJ. During the applicable Exclusive Period, SFJ shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, either by itself or through a Third Party, conduct human clinical trials of, or sell, offer for sale or have sold:
input.rationale: The only exclusivity/competing-product covenant in the Agreement (Section 3.19, read with the "Competing Product", "Brilinta Competing Product" and "Exclusive Period" definitions) binds SFJ and its Affiliates, not PB. It is a restraint on the counterparty and therefore favours us; we do not flag it. We reviewed every PB-side restraint: the Article 7 negative covenants (7.5.1-7.5.7) are financing covenants (indebtedness, subordinated debt, liens/negative pledge, distributions and investments, royalty-stream sales) and the Section 7.5.5 Licensing Transaction consent right is a licensing/transfer restriction on PB Intellectual Property relating to the Product, subject to a Material Impact standard and expedited arbitration, with Excluded Licensing Transactions (including licences of PB's own ELP technology such as PB1046 and PB1023) expressly permitted "without SFJ's consent". None of these prevents PB from operating any business, or from developing, acquiring, buying or selling any product, so there is no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. Section 15.15 confirms all rights not expressly granted are reserved to PB. This meets the preferred position; no redline is warranted.
